SASBDB entry SASDVX2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVX2/)

Publication: Dissecting the Conformational Heterogeneity of Stem-Loop Substructures of the Fifth Element in the 5'-Untranslated Region of SARS-CoV-2.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1021/jacs.4c08406

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDVX2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
